label: CKD review: Review monthly Invega Sustenna when CrCl is below 50 mL/min
title: Review monthly Invega Sustenna when CrCl is below 50 mL/min
statement: For an adult outpatient with established CKD, review monthly Invega Sustenna when CrCl is below 50 mL/min.

plain_summary: For an adult outpatient with established CKD, review monthly Invega Sustenna when CrCl is below 50 mL/min.

medicine_groups.name: Monthly Invega Sustenna depot injection
medicine_groups.note: Use only the identified Invega Sustenna injection. An ingredient-only line must identify that depot formulation. Exclude oral tablets. Both initiation and maintenance supplies of the monthly product count.

needs_facts.meets: Dated Cockcroft-Gault CrCl below 50 mL/min during stable kidney function at supply. If the test date, method or unit is unclear, the clearance remains unknown.
CKD was established by the supply under review. If its timing is uncertain, keep the finding possible unless another fact rules it out.

options.words: CKD was established by the supply under review
CKD was absent at the supply under review

rule_for_models: Apply only to outpatients aged 18 or older with established CKD. If age is missing and the record could otherwise qualify, report only a possible finding and ask for age at supply. Check only monthly Invega Sustenna paliperidone palmitate at CrCl <50 mL/min, as a prompt to review an unrecommended regimen. Exclude oral Invega tablets, Invega Trinza, Invega Hafyera and other depot formulations. An identified Invega Sustenna syringe starts the check even if its directions say only “for clinic administration”. If only paliperidone is named and the formulation is unclear, ask which product was supplied and report at most a possible finding if it could qualify. If the depot is identified and the record could otherwise qualify, report only a possible finding when CKD or the applicable CrCl is missing. Name each missing fact and cite the available lines. Report a finding for the qualifying depot below 50 mL/min. Cite the supply, established CKD and dated stable Cockcroft-Gault CrCl in mL/min. Give no finding for a known exclusion or CrCl of 50 mL/min or more. This review does not require a particular dose or indication.
cannot_be_seen: A supply record does not show whether or when the clinic gave the injection. Kidney results obtained elsewhere, their units and their timing may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Could you confirm the current Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance in mL/min and review the next Invega Sustenna injection before it is given? Its use is not recommended below 50 mL/min. If the injection is due today, could we discuss it today?
